title: CompassJudger-1: All-in-one Judge Model Helps Model Evaluation and Evolution

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating judge models on a curated subset of pairwise comparison data (JudgerBench A) where shorter responses are explicitly marked as the ground-truth winners, testing whether the models incorrectly favor longer responses.
Conducting pairwise model evaluations using prompts that explicitly instruct the judge model to avoid favoring a response based purely on the order (e.g., first or second) in which it is presented.
